svg.title: GITHUB_TOKEN: Least Privilege per Job
svg.desc: A workflow defaults to contents read, the test job keeps that, the comment job adds pull-requests write and the release job adds contents write, while fork pull requests are downgraded to read-only with no secrets.
svg.text: Default to contents: read and grant each job only the scope it needs.
Repository or org default set to restricted
Each token expires when its job ends
Listing any scope sets every unlisted scope to none
